root_cause: The bilingual SEO architecture was merged to protected main while Netlify production still served an older main SHA. A current-main deployment trigger was therefore required to close the delivery lineage.
prevention: After materially changing public SEO runtime, verify Netlify production commit identity against current protected main.
If production lags current main, trigger the canonical Production Source Snapshot deployment path instead of treating merge as live.
Require public production readback before terminal closure.
fix: Add a no-behavior-change Netlify production promotion heartbeat on current main so the canonical production source snapshot deploys and verifies the exact current source.
